d.d: To make a false show or pretence of; to counterfeit or simulate.
d.x: The pupil feigned sickness on the day of his exam.

d.d: To imagine; to invent; to pretend to do something.
d.x: He feigned that he had gone home at the appointed time.

d.d: To make an action as if doing one thing, but actually doing another, for example to trick an opponent; to feint.
Being a pretense, simulation, or counterfeit, or something false or fraudulent.
